title: The Locked Room Mystery
content:
Detective Emma Carter had investigated many strange cases, but this one was particularly unusual.

One cold evening, she received a call from an old mansion on the edge of town. The owner, Mr. Wilson, had disappeared from his office, and the door was locked from the inside.

When Emma arrived, the atmosphere was extremely quiet. The house was very old, and the long, dark hallway was quite frightening. Something about the place made her feel too uncomfortable to relax.

— There must be an explanation — Emma said. — If we look carefully, we will find something.

Inside the office, everything seemed normal. A cup of tea was still on the desk, and a newspaper was lying on the floor. However, there were almost no clues.

Emma examined the windows, but they were locked. She checked the walls and the floor, but there were no secret doors. The room was too small for someone to hide, and there wasn't enough space behind the furniture.

Her assistant, Daniel, looked nervous.

— What if someone has kidnapped Mr. Wilson? — he asked.

— If someone entered this room, they will have left evidence — Emma replied.

Daniel started searching through the drawers. Suddenly, he found a small silver key.

— This is quite interesting — Emma said. — If this key opens something, we will finally understand what happened.

They continued searching the room until Emma noticed something unusual. One of the bookshelves was slightly different from the others. The dust on the floor was too clean near the wall.

— If we move this bookshelf, we will discover what is behind it — she said.

Together, they pushed the heavy furniture aside. Behind it, they found a narrow passage.

The passage was very dark, but Emma was brave enough to enter.

— If Mr. Wilson is inside, we will find him — she whispered.

At the end of the passage, they discovered a small hidden room. Mr. Wilson was sitting there, completely safe.

He looked surprised when he saw them.

— I didn't disappear — he explained. — I found this secret room and became too curious to leave.

Emma sighed.

— You have caused a very serious problem — she said. — If you disappear without telling anyone again, we will probably have another mystery to solve.

Everyone laughed, but Emma knew one thing: if people are too curious, they will sometimes find themselves in unexpected places.
